title: NoSQL and Specialized Data Stores knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which topic is explicitly listed in the syllabus coverage for “NoSQL and Specialized Data Stores”?
options: Choosing storage based on application needs

questions.prompt: According to the worked example in “NoSQL and Specialized Data Stores”, which result should the learner verify?
options: The app publishes itself to production and passes all tests automatically.
HTTP 500 is returned for every valid request.
Input validation and authorization are disabled by design.
questions.explanation: The worked example explicitly documents this expected result. Reproduce it locally in the listed environment before treating it as tested behavior.

questions.prompt: Which database practice is strongest for this lesson? (NoSQL and Specialized Data Stores)
options: Use constraints, parameterized queries and clear transaction boundaries; verify changes on synthetic test data
Concatenate raw user input into SQL statements
Assume schema auto-generation is always safe to apply in production
questions.answer_key: Use constraints, parameterized queries and clear transaction boundaries; verify changes on synthetic test data
questions.explanation: Data integrity and safe transactions need explicit boundaries and targeted failure tests.
